about: Hand-written content. 'moods' are the home-page spreads: picks are café ids, in the order shown. 'takes' are the Order this / Go when / Skip if notes on each details page; leave a field out and it isn't shown. First drafts are built only from the barista notes and hard facts (pure-veg, price): rewrite them in your own words.

moods.title: Chai & a long adda
moods.note: Cutting chai, something fried, and nowhere to be. Pull up a chair.

moods.title: Serious coffee
moods.note: For when the coffee is the point, not the side.

moods.title: Dress up for it
moods.note: Birthdays, anniversaries, first dates you want to go well.

moods.title: Big table, no arguments
moods.note: Six people, six cravings. These menus have something for all of them.

moods.title: Slow afternoons
moods.note: Quiet corners for a long brunch, a book, or a catch-up that runs over.

tapri-central-c-scheme.order: Cutting chai and a plate of Maggi.

zolocrust-malviya-nagar.order: Something from the bakery, then the pasta.
zolocrust-malviya-nagar.go_when: Late, when the city's slowing down and you're still hungry.

cafe-bae-bais-godam.order: Something Thai, and a drink from the bar.

curious-life-coffee-roasters-sarojini-ma.order: A black coffee, at least once.

on-the-house-c-scheme.go_when: With a group that can't pick a cuisine.

sultanat-malviya-nagar.skip_if: You want meat. It's all pure-veg.

nibs-experia-c-scheme.go_when: A date, or a catch-up you've been putting off.

anokhi-cafe-c-scheme.order: Fresh bakes and an honest coffee.

the-johri-pink-city.skip_if: You're on a tight budget. It's ₹800+ for two.

the-eclectica-sodala.skip_if: You want meat. It's all pure-veg.

brown-sugar-restaurant-cafe-bakery-c-sch.order: A slice of cake on the way out.

quyu-s-cafe-vaishali-nagar.order: Dessert. Save real room for it.

nothing-before-coffee-durgapura.go_when: You need a quick caffeine fix.

dzurt-patisserie-and-cafe-civil-lines.order: Pastries, and a box to take home.

once-upon-a-time-at-the-bagh-agra-road.skip_if: You're on a tight budget. It's ₹800+ for two.

indian-coffee-house-mi-road.skip_if: You want polish. It's proudly old-school.

cafe-nola-malviya-nagar.skip_if: You want a sure thing. It's still finding its feet.

jacobs-brew-house-malviya-nagar.go_when: For the look: it's a retro, record-store space.
jacobs-brew-house-malviya-nagar.skip_if: You go by reviews. They're mixed.
